reason: Conversation 1 ran the sensible checks (pump hum, impeller, external hose, sink) efficiently, correctly identified FD 9409 as a production code, kept the sump-hose blockage open as a residual possibility, and pointed to the E-Nr or an engineer before buying a pump, matching the ground truth almost exactly. Both handled unplugging adequately, so safety was not decisive; honesty of diagnosis and part-identification guidance were.
